_about: Curated REAL facts (static, not live) from NASA Technical Reports Server records on CELSS (Controlled Ecological Life Support System) crops. Verified 2026-11-14 on the citation pages / NTRS API abstracts. Edit by hand.

source.product: CELSS crop studies — quinoa and spirulina

quinoa.citation: Schlick, G. & Bubenheim, D. L. (1993). Quinoa: An emerging new crop with potential for CELSS. NASA TP-3422, NASA Ames Research Center.
quinoa.note: Considered for CELSS for its high protein (12–18 %) and lysine near FAO standards; hydroponic greenhouse trials; cultivars under 70 cm.

spirulina.citation: Tadros, M. G. (1993). Characterization of Spirulina biomass for CELSS diet potential. NASA-CR-194123; Tadros (1988) NASA-CR-185329; Oguchi et al. (1987) Food production and gas exchange system using blue-green alga (spirulina) for CELSS.
spirulina.note: Edible alga for the crew in a CELSS; cultures evolve oxygen; total proteins up to almost 70 % of organic weight under optimum conditions.
